params.title: Night Bus Home
params.stylePrompt: warm indie folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, clear close upfront lead vocal, crisp diction, gentle and tired but hopeful mood, sparse arrangement, dry and intimate
params.lyrics:
[verse]
Streetlights slide across my tired hands
The night bus hums me home

[chorus]
Take me home, take me slow
Windows glowing in the rain

[verse]
Driver nods and I nod back
Quiet faces, one long road

[chorus]
Take me home, take me slow
Windows glowing in the rain
